    Robert Morris
    Indiana State Representative

    AI Overview
    Robert Morris (born c. 1961/1962) is a former Texas megachurch pastor who founded Gateway Church and served as a spiritual advisor to Donald Trump
    . He resigned in June 2024 following accusations of sexual abuse of a minor in the 1980s. In October 2025, he pleaded guilty to child sexual assault charges, receiving a six-month jail sentence and 9.5 years probation. 
    Key Details Regarding Robert Morris (Pastor): 
    • Conviction and Sentencing: Morris pleaded guilty to five counts of indecency with a child. He was sentenced to 180 days (6 months) in the Osage County Jail in Oklahoma, followed by 9.5 years probation.
    • Release: According to reports on March 31, 2026, Morris completed his six-month sentence and was released
      .
    • Sex Offender Registration: As part of his plea deal, he is required to register as a sex offender.
    • Background: He founded Gateway Church in Southlake, Texas, in 2000, growing it into one of the largest megachurches in the United States.
    • Restitution: He was ordered to pay $270,000 in restitution to the victim. 
    Other notable individuals named Robert Morris include the American Minimalist artist (1931–2018) and the American Revolutionary "Financier" (1734–1806).

    Robert Preston Morris is an American former televangelist, pastor, and convicted child sex offender. He founded Gateway Church, a megachurch in Southlake, Texas, in 2000 and served as its senior pastor until 2024, when he resigned after being publicly accused of sexually assaulting a 12-year-old girl in the 1980s.
